'''Sunberry trees''' were [[Plant/Legends|plants]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]] that produced the [[Sunberry/Legends|sunberry]], a small [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that was desired by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] for its use in local remedies. The [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] witch [[Morag]] tried several times to destroy the Ewok crop of sunberry trees with help from her [[Condor dragon/Legends|Mantigrue]] in order to take away a valuable source of medicine from the Ewoks.
